# SmartAssPDF

> SmartAssPDF (https://smartasspdf.com) is a free, privacy-first, open-source-powered web platform for PDF, document, and image conversion, organization, security, and optical character recognition (OCR) workflows.

## Primary Capabilities (24 Live Tools)

### Convert from PDF
- **OCR PDF**: `/tools/ocr-pdf.html` â€” Performs Optical Character Recognition using Tesseract OCR to convert scanned documents and flat image PDFs into searchable, selectable text with multi-language support (English, Spanish, French, German).
- **PDF to Word (DOCX)**: `/tools/pdf-to-word.html` â€” Converts PDF pages into editable Microsoft Word (.docx) documents with 1:1 layout preservation, tables, vector rules, and embedded graphics.
- **PDF to Excel (XLSX)**: `/tools/pdf-to-excel.html` â€” Extracts structured tabular data and matrices into auto-formatted Excel spreadsheets (.xlsx) with numeric cell typing.
- **PDF to JPG**: `/tools/pdf-to-jpg.html` â€” Renders PDF pages into high-resolution JPG images (100 to 300 DPI) packaged as a ZIP archive for multi-page documents.
- **PDF to PowerPoint (PPTX)**: `/tools/pdf-to-ppt.html` â€” Exports PDF pages into high-fidelity PowerPoint slide decks (.pptx).

### Convert to PDF
- **Word to PDF**: `/tools/word-to-pdf.html` â€” Converts DOCX files into universal, printer-ready PDF files with full typography and margin preservation.
- **Excel to PDF**: `/tools/excel-to-pdf.html` â€” Renders spreadsheet worksheets and tables into paginated, grid-lined PDF documents.
- **Image to PDF**: `/tools/image-to-pdf.html` â€” Converts JPG, PNG, and JPEG images into a unified, clean PDF document.
- **HTML to PDF**: `/tools/html-to-pdf.html` â€” Renders HTML markup, CSS layouts, web typography, and tables into paginated PDF pages.

### Optimize, Security & Document Integrity
- **Repair PDF**: `/tools/repair-pdf.html` â€” Diagnoses and recovers damaged, unreadable, or corrupted PDF files by parsing broken cross-reference (XREF) tables and restoring orphaned content streams using QPDF and PDFBox.
- **Compare PDFs**: `/tools/compare-pdf.html` â€” Performs visual and textual diff analysis between two PDF versions, rendering side-by-side pages with highlighted additions, deletions, and structural alterations.
- **Sanitize PDF**: `/tools/sanitize-pdf.html` â€” Strips hidden metadata packets (XMP, EXIF), author names, GPS tags, document revision histories, embedded thumbnails, and tracking IDs for complete privacy before publishing.
- **Sign PDF**: `/tools/sign-pdf.html` â€” Applies cryptographic digital certificate signatures (.p12 / PFX) and stamped signature seals onto documents.
- **Image to WebP**: `/tools/image-to-webp.html` â€” Converts PNG, JPG, and JPEG images into modern, ultra-compressed WebP format with alpha transparency preservation.
- **Compress PDF**: `/tools/compress-pdf.html` â€” Reduces PDF file size by 60â€“80% using multi-stage image downsampling and object stream optimization.
- **Protect PDF**: `/tools/protect-pdf.html` â€” Enforces 256-bit AES password encryption and permission restrictions on PDF files.
- **Unlock PDF**: `/tools/unlock-pdf.html` â€” Removes password protection from authorized PDFs when the decryption key is supplied.
- **Add Watermark**: `/tools/add-watermark.html` â€” Stamps custom text or graphic watermarks with customizable opacity, rotation, and positioning.

### Organize PDF
- **Merge PDF**: `/tools/merge-pdf.html` â€” Combines multiple PDF files into one ordered document.
- **Split PDF**: `/tools/split-pdf.html` â€” Extracts individual pages or custom ranges (e.g. `1-3, 5, 8-10`) with ZIP bundling.
- **Remove Pages**: `/tools/remove-pages.html` â€” Deletes unwanted pages from any PDF document.
- **Rotate PDF**: `/tools/rotate-pdf.html` â€” Rotates PDF pages clockwise by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
- **Add Page Numbers**: `/tools/add-page-numbers.html` â€” Inserts formatted page numbers (e.g. "Page X of Y") into headers or footers.

## Technology Stack & Architecture

- **Zero-Storage Privacy Model**: Files reside exclusively in temporary, isolated UUID server directories with automated hard deletion after 30 minutes. No user database, no persistent tracking, and zero AI training on user files.
- **Backend API**: Java 17 LTS, Spring Boot 3 REST API on `/api/v1`.
- **Core Processing Engines**:
  - Apache PDFBox 3.0 (PDF rendering, security encryption, object stream compression, and page manipulation).
  - Tesseract OCR (Optical Character Recognition and searchable PDF generation).
  - QPDF (Deep stream reconstruction, linearization, and XREF repair).
  - PyMuPDF / fitz (High-speed vector layout parsing, diffing, and table extraction).
  - Apache POI (Office DOCX/XLSX/PPTX handling).
  - LibreOffice Headless (Native document compiler for Word, Excel, and HTML rendering).
  - Pillow / PIL (High-performance WebP and image processing).

## API Endpoints

- `GET /api/v1/tools`: Lists all available tools and backend health status.
- `POST /api/v1/tools/{tool}/jobs`: Accepts multipart form uploads (`files`) with optional processing parameters and returns job UUID and download URLs.
- `GET /api/v1/jobs/{jobId}/download`: Streams the resulting converted document.
